verdict.rationale: Antigravity's docs show natural-language code commands, autonomous operation across editor/terminal/browser, and subagents that can run tests and search codebases (docs-6,7,9,18,46), which collectively support debugging/troubleshooting via NL prompts, but there is no explicit documentation of a dedicated 'debug' workflow or troubleshooting examples, and community reports focus on stability/security issues rather than confirming debugging quality. Missing for 10: explicit debugging-specific documentation or examples, and independent hands-on validation that NL debugging queries work reliably.
